promptEs: Escribí el cifrado latino equivalente al cifrado americano Gm7♭5.
promptEn: Write the Latin chord symbol equivalent to the American chord Gm7♭5.
explanationEs: Gm7♭5 se convierte en Solm7♭5: G pasa a Sol y la semidisminución se mantiene.
explanationEn: Gm7♭5 becomes Solm7♭5: G becomes Sol and the half-diminished qualifier is kept.
